Navel Laser Quirk.name: Navel Laser Quirk
Navel Laser Quirk.description:
🔦 You make a bright laser beam from your navel.

🌱 At the start you aim your abdomen across a classroom to fire a brief straight beam, knock one adult back or cut a thin obstacle.
📈 With training: precise cuts, controlled bursts for flight, falling debris cleared, stronger shots that break heavy barriers.
⚠️ You get stomach cramps from sustained fire; opaque cover blocks your beam, poor visibility spoils aim, and you cannot fire safely with someone against your navel.
🔗 Canon Drawback, built in: Bodily Toll, as repeated firing brings abdominal pain.
🎬 Canon Quirk: Yuga Aoyama's Navel Laser. You are not related to him; people who know his Quirk notice the resemblance.

📈 Grants: Technique +1, Quirk Output +10, Quirk Control +10, Marksmanship +5
⚡ Starting techniques: Belly Beam, Bright Guard
🛡️ Resists: light
Navel Laser Quirk.traitNarrativeEffects:
Scale: navel laser. Start: a classroom-length burst knocks a person back, scorches a small surface or, held steady, cuts a thin obstacle. Aim with the abdomen; straight beam, never around cover. Longer firing, stronger cuts, beam-driven movement need training.
Limits: sustained firing soon brings aim-ruining stomach cramps. Not through own body or safe with someone pressed to it. Opaque cover blocks it; smoke hides aim, not beam. Burns bystanders, ignites materials. Optional focusing belt or lens shapes it, adds no power.
Quirk Strain: light: short shot, guard; moderate: precise cut, brief lift, repeated burst; heavy: barrier break, beam held through a rescue; severe: signature shot, building-scale output.
Drawback: built in, the canon Bodily Toll.
Canon: Yuga Aoyama's Quirk; user is unrelated, no tie unless the story makes one; those who know it see the resemblance.
Type: Emitter.
Law: public firing, offensive or rescue, needs lawful authority.
Look: pale beam.
